summaryZh: 五代后晋官修唐史，多直接抄录唐代实录、国史，故保存原始材料最多。北宋以后《新唐书》行世，本书一度稀见，清人重刻后与新书并用。治唐史者，纪传往往先旧后新，志则两书不可偏废。
summaryEn: The Later Jin court’s Tang history, close to Tang veritable records and national histories, and therefore often more primary. After the Xin Tangshu appeared it nearly dropped from circulation; Qing reprints restored it. Scholars usually read biographies in both books.
notes: 文宗以后部分成书仓促，质量不如前半。
《经籍志》可与《新唐书·艺文志》对勘。
